units.source_text: 我摸不着头脑，也从金阁走了下来，

en.t: I was bewildered and came down from the Golden Pavilion as well,

units.source_text: 在池畔追上女人的时候，腿长的美国兵已经捷足跑了过去，一把揪住了女人的鲜红的大衣的前襟。

en.t: and when I caught up with the woman by the pond, the long-legged American soldier had already run ahead and grabbed the front of her bright red coat.
